परिचय · About Us

Swami Santsharan Sanskrit Vidyapeeth

Located at Hanumant Kunj Ashram, Shivpuri Chapdoh, Swami Santsharan Sanskrit Vidyapeeth stands at the meeting point of Sanskrit language, Vedic tradition, and modern education. Students are guided here from Prathama (Class 6th level) through to Shastri (B.A. level), with discipline and values woven into every stage.

Our purpose goes beyond textbook knowledge — it is character-building. Students gain a combined understanding of Sanskrit, dharma-shastra, and contemporary subjects, while living a disciplined gurukul way of life.

6th – B.A. Prathama to Shastri
Ashram-based Residential learning
Sanskar Discipline & values

Academic Journey

The Path from Prathama to Shastri

Education at our Vidyapeeth follows the traditional Sanskrit-vidya stages, deepening a student's knowledge and understanding at every level.

  1. 01

    Prathama

    The starting point, at Class 6th level — Sanskrit grammar, vocabulary, and an introduction to foundational texts.

  2. 02

    Purva-Madhyama

    A broader study of Sanskrit literature, grammar, and scriptures at the middle level.

  3. 03

    Uttar-Madhyama

    Senior secondary level — in-depth study of scriptural debate, poetry, and philosophy (equivalent to 10+2).

  4. 04

    Shastri

    Graduate (B.A.) level degree — specialisation in Sanskrit, Vedic scripture, and related subjects.
